request: Command-W closes an agent; no tiling; the preview strip replaces the tab row with scrolloff navigation; harness status with a pulse until the agent is selected; agents never inherit parent-agent markers; OLED black theme
changes: Split panes built earlier the same day were removed at the user's request, including the pane_tree module and registry pane groups
No tab row: the strip of live previews under the stage is the category's navigation, with sidescrolloff-style scrolling and a trailing new-agent card
Preview cards never take input or resize a PTY, redraw at most every 250 ms and show the rows ending at the cursor at half scale
Unseen agents (finished or needing a response while another was selected) pulse on their card and category until selected
Status sources: Codex observer; Claude --settings hooks writing a private activity file; output estimate labelled Output active/Quiet for other harnesses
Command-W closes the focused agent through the session service terminate frame (SIGHUP, SIGTERM at 1.5 s, SIGKILL at 3 s); unreachable agents need an explicit abandon
The session service clears parent-agent session markers before starting agents
OLED black theme; live agents' placeholder screens use engine defaults instead of the sample palette

linux_full_gate.includes: build, clang-format, cppcheck, clang-tidy shards, all CTest suites under Xvfb

validation.claude_hook_probe: Claude Code 2.1.280, claude -p --model haiku --settings <generated file>: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop fired in order (idle, working, finished)
validation.gui_strip_assertions: no tab row, cards below stage, click selects, non-interactive throttled cards, scrolloff both directions, pulse rules and colors, category dot, short window, hide preference, Command-W on ended agent, new-agent card

limitations: Native macOS key delivery was not re-run; GUI tests use synthetic Qt events on Linux
Claude PreToolUse and Notification hooks were exercised through /bin/sh with the generated commands, not through a live permission prompt
Claude agents created before this change have no hooks and use the output estimate until recreated
The output estimate is advisory; a TUI that redraws without working, or works silently, will read wrongly
Agents started by earlier service builds cannot be ended from lapis until restarted
integration_note: On merge with PR #10 (feature/agent-strip), the desktop-side Claude --settings hooks were replaced by PR #10's service-side Claude Code adapter (AgentMode::claude). The claude_hook_probe above describes the replaced route; the adapter's own qualification is evidence/claude-code-hooks.json.
